scope: Unity scene logic with simulated XR hit poses; not a physical-device AR test
checks: No placement without a valid hit
Valid horizontal hit shows reticle without placing the model
Tap places at hit pose in transformed local reference space
Model base rests on the detected surface
Placed model stays fixed when the viewer moves and rotates
Scanning another surface does not move an already placed model
Another tap repositions the same model
Wall hit rejected; invalid tap preserves placement
Lost tracking keeps the existing placement
A new AR session clears old placement and stale hits
Leaving AR restores centered desktop preview
